data.name: Secrets of the Grave
data.description: You gain a +%1 bonus on Knowledge (religion) checks made to identify undead creatures and their abilities. You may use mind-affecting spells to affect undead as if they were living creatures, even if they are mindless (though spells that affect only humanoids do not affect them, even if they were humanoids in life). In addition, you may add one necromancy spell from the spell list of any arcane spellcasting class to your list of spells known at 2nd level and every four levels thereafter.|SecretsOfTheGraveBonus
